sheets.name: README
rows: Traceability view for one regulation-to-SHACL generation run.
Generation is frozen before RDF execution; no ship graph or hidden expected outcome is used here.
events.jsonl is append-only; CSV and Excel sheets are derived views.
Static validation passed and the semantic validator accepted the candidate.
No verified canonical term was available; the generator was not allowed to invent one.
Accepted shapes await the separate bulk evaluator.

sheets.name: RUNS
rows: Candidate faithfully encodes the required ship-level capability, RCC voice/data declaration, and membership of both exact MHz frequency values using SHACL Core qualified-value constraints with required numeric values.

sheets.name: ITERATIONS
rows: Replace the SPARQL numeric equality checks for 121.5 and 123.1 with SHACL Core qualified-value membership constraints on nltl:supportedAircraftVoiceFrequency. For each required frequency, require at least one quantity value with qudt:unit unit:MegaHZ and qudt:numericValue constrained by equal sh:minInclusive and sh:maxInclusive decimal bounds (121.5 respectively 123.1). Preserve the existing ship target and required boolean true constraints.

Preserve the required ship target and boolean true constraints, and retain the two separate SHACL Core qualified-value membership constraints. Add sh:minCount 1 to each inner qudt:numericValue property shape; without it, a MHz quantity value with no numeric value satisfies both qualified shapes, creating an accidental pass.

Candidate faithfully encodes the required ship-level capability, RCC voice/data declaration, and membership of both exact MHz frequency values using SHACL Core qualified-value constraints with required numeric values.
